# Qamira Consulting

> Qamira Consulting is a business advisory and technology firm. We advise owner-led and mid-sized businesses on what to change, and build the systems that change it: custom software, CRMs, websites, AI chatbots and receptionists, and business automation. Work is fixed price and delivered in weeks. Our team is based in India and works remotely across Indian, Australian, UK and European business hours.

We work with owner-led and mid-sized businesses and growing startups in India, Australia, the UK, the US and the UAE. Clients use our advisory practice, our technology practice, or both. The easiest place to start is the free AI Business Assessment, or a free 20-minute call.

## Core methodology

- [QBPES™ Methodology](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/methodology): Our method for assessing a business: eight connected areas (strategy, financial performance, process, people, data, technology, customer, governance), each scored on a five-level maturity scale, and an eight-step delivery process.
- [QBPES™ Business Assessment](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/advisory/qbpes-assessment): A full, fixed-price assessment of a business across all eight areas, with a target operating model and a sequenced roadmap of the changes worth making. Six to twelve weeks.
- [Qamira GrowthOS™](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/growth-os): Our growth operating system. It connects how a business wins, converts, delivers and measures customers into one continuous loop: Diagnose, Strategise, Acquire, Convert, Deliver, Measure, Optimise and Scale.
- [AI Solutions](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/ai-solutions): How we use AI in our own work: every finding cites its evidence, client data is never used to train shared models, and a person reviews every recommendation.

## What we do

- [Services](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/services): Every service we offer, from free assessments and process reviews to custom software, CRMs, chatbots, websites, training and managed support.
- [Technology](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/technology): What our technology practice builds: websites and online stores, SEO and AI search visibility, custom software, CRMs, AI chatbots, AI receptionists, HR software, marketing automation, AI video and content scheduling, internal knowledge assistants, document data extraction and systems integration.
- [Websites & Online Stores](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/technology/websites): Fast, mobile-first websites and online stores built to turn visitors into enquiries, bookings and orders.
- [SEO & AI Search Visibility (GEO)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/technology/seo-geo): Search optimisation for a business's site and local listings, plus visibility in AI assistants such as ChatGPT.
- [AI Chatbots](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/technology/ai-chatbots): Website and WhatsApp chatbots trained on a business's own services and policies, which answer, book and capture leads.
- [HR Software](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/technology/hr-software): Staff records, leave, hiring and reviews in one place, built around how the business manages people.
- [AI Receptionist (Australia)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/au/ai-receptionist): A done-for-you AI receptionist for Australian tradies, clinics and service businesses -- answers calls 24/7, books jobs, quotes from the business's own rate card, hands off to staff by callback and logs every call to the CRM.
- [AI Receptionist (UK)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/uk/ai-receptionist): An AI receptionist for UK businesses that answers calls 24/7, books appointments and hands off to staff, set up to meet UK GDPR and call-recording notice rules.
- [AI Receptionist (US)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/us/ai-receptionist): An AI receptionist for US businesses that answers calls 24/7, books appointments and hands off to staff, set up for state call-recording consent rules.
- [Google Business Profile Optimisation (Australia)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/au/google-business-profile): Done-for-you Google Business Profile and local SEO setup for Australian tradies, clinics and local service businesses -- profile set up or cleaned up, categories, service areas, photos, a review request process and consistent citation listings.
- [AI & Process Consulting (Melbourne)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/au/ai-process-consulting-melbourne): AI and process consulting for Melbourne small businesses -- AI receptionists and chatbots, workflow automation, process reviews and local search for clinics, trades and professional firms, delivered remotely with a fixed price up front.
- [Business Consultant in Pune](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/in/business-consultant-pune): Business consulting for growing SMEs in Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad -- process improvement, AI automation, KPIs and systems for manufacturers, logistics firms and professional-services companies, on-site or online.
- [Custom Software (India)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/in/custom-software): Custom software, ERP and client portals for growing Indian businesses, with a written scope and fixed quote before work starts.
- [ERP & CRM Builds (India)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/in/erp-crm-development): CRM and custom ERP builds set up around how an Indian business sells and operates.
- [Business Automation (India)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/in/business-automation): Connects Tally, Excel, CRM and other tools so data is typed once, without a forced switch to new software.
- [WhatsApp & Website AI Chatbot (India)](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/in/ai-chatbot): One AI assistant on a business's WhatsApp number and website, in English and Hindi, that answers customers and captures enquiries.

## Industry accelerators

Each applies the same eight areas and delivery process, with the KPIs, process maps and benchmarks that sector usually needs.

- [Manufacturing](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/industries/manufacturing): Operational OEE, supply chain logistics, demand analytics.
- [Logistics & Supply Chain](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/industries/logistics-supply-chain): Fleet utilisation, route efficiency, warehouse analytics.
- [Construction & Infrastructure](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/industries/construction-infrastructure): Resource management, project drift tracking.
- [Retail & E-Commerce](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/industries/retail-ecommerce): CAC/LTV models, inventory turns, customer journey.
- [Healthcare](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/industries/healthcare): Patient flow, cost optimisation, resource allocation.
- [Financial Services](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/industries/financial-services): Risk architecture, operational throughput, executive reporting.
- [Professional Services](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/industries/professional-services): Resource utilisation, project profitability.
- [Growing Startups & Tech](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/industries/startups-tech): Agility mapping, burn-rate optimisation.
- [Public Sector & Education](https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/industries/public-sector-education): Resource allocation, compliance management.
